Title: agents/state.py — Define shared state contracts

Description:
**Module/Path:** api/routes/analyze.py
**Complexity:** Moderate

**Dependencies:** Supabase

**Notes/Debt**
PR open for review — adds 3x retry with exponential backoff; dead-letter queue deferred to a follow-up.

Title: Improve LLM evaluator failure handling
Description:
**Module/Path:** agents/manager_agent.py
**Complexity:** Moderate

**Function Purpose**

**Dependencies:** Anthropic Claude

**Notes/Debt**
Under review — proposal is to fail closed (retry once, then abort-to-human-review) instead of fail-open.
